evidence:
host/native/feed-service.lisp:23 (defconstant +fnn-feed-poll-seconds+ 1/20)
feed-service.lisp:549-558
       (loop until (fnn-feed-stoppingp runtime) do
         (fnn-feed-refresh-links runtime)      ; -> fnn-feed-peer-list -> fnn-owner-transit-serialized
         (let ((now (fnn-feed-now)))
           (dolist (link (fnn-feed-links runtime))
             ... (fnn-feed-pump-link runtime link now)))   ; -> fnn-feed-tick -> fnn-owner-transit-serialized
         (sleep +fnn-feed-poll-seconds+))
fix: Have ACL2 return the next due instant (offer, backoff or keepalive) and sleep until then. Wake on a commit or configuration signal (fnn-owner-signal-commit already exists) instead of a fixed 50 ms poll.
notes: GPT-6.1-Sol: imported feed idle condition wait and native regression; no matching native verdict yet.
reviewer: feed-service.lisp:23 sets the cadence to 1/20 s. Every iteration calls fnn-feed-refresh-links, which calls fnn-feed-peer-list and enters fnn-owner-transit-serialized (lines 110-114). For each link it then calls fnn-feed-dial, which runs fnn-feed-dial-plan, also serialized, whenever there is no socket and the backoff is due. For each ready link it calls fnn-feed-tick, serialized as well (lines 254-256), followed by a zero-second recv (line 245-252). Every serialized entry goes through fnn-owner-gated (owner.lisp:1573), with space preobservation, gate enter/leave and the owner mutex. That is about 20 x (1+N) owner quanta per second while idle. This is a real constant background load, but a performance issue rather than a correctness one.
scenario: With N ready peers and nothing to send, the worker still takes 20 x (1 + N) owner quanta per second, each with gate scheduling, a clock event and journal and log offers (fnn-owner-advance-clock/disk events inside ticks). Every one of them competes with readers and the committer for the single owner mutex. On the 1-CPU, 2 GB friend node this is a constant background load, and it adds to scheduler wait and decision-journal volume.
title: Feed worker enters the owner gate 20 times a second, with no work to do
